app.name: Finora
app.description: A modern receivables and contract platform for LME-priced metals trading.

auth.loginSubtitle: Sign in to your trading desk
auth.demoHint: Demo mode — any email and password will sign you in.

landing.heroTitle: Run your trading desk on a single source of truth
landing.heroSubtitle: Finora turns spreadsheets into a real platform — track LME-priced contracts, container shipments, invoices and customer balances with clarity and control.
landing.trustedBy: Trusted by trading desks moving metal worldwide
landing.featuresSubtitle: From contract to cash — purpose-built for the metals trade.
landing.feature1Desc: Model fixed or floating LME, percentages and premiums per item. Prices and invoices compute automatically.
landing.feature2Desc: Every contract holds many goods with quantity, incoterm, status and remaining MT tracked in real time.
landing.feature3Desc: Follow each container from shipment to arrival to payment, with due-date and overdue alerts.
landing.feature4Desc: Live outstanding, overdue and collection rate per customer — in USD and AED.
landing.feature5Desc: USD and AED with configurable FX. Record payments in any currency, report in one.
landing.feature6Desc: English, Arabic and Persian with full right-to-left support, dark and light themes.
landing.ctaSubtitle: Explore the full platform with realistic demo data — no setup required.
